'''Bharatine''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. She allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] during the split.

== Appearance ==
Bharatine is thin, yet graceful, with a long nose. Though thin as a rail, she manages to look elegant.

== Strength==
Bharatine is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]] with a strength level of {{opsl|39}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Bharatine|Bharatine}}

==History==
She was born in {{ne|921}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|936}} at the age of 15. She spent nine years as a [[novice]] and seven years as [[Accepted]]. She was raised to the shawl in {{ne|952}}.

== Activities ==
She is one of the Aes Sedai who joined in the [[Link]] with [[Anaiya]] when the [[Bubble of evil]] erupted in [[Salidar]].

She is one of the sisters who crowd into the room after [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] Heals [[Logain Ablar]], restoring his ability to channel.{{ref||Bharatine}}
